name: ecosystem-skills
description: The three core SE Ranking + Planable ecosystem use cases: whole-footprint map across search, AI answers and social, plus the two campaigns that close the gaps it finds.

interface.shortDescription: See your whole footprint, then close the gaps
interface.longDescription: The three core use cases for the SE Ranking + Planable ecosystem. Map a brand's topics across search rankings, AI-answer citations and social performance at once; turn real search demand into a drafted social campaign in Planable; and claim the narratives AI answers currently give to competitors. Every campaign ships instrumented, so re-running the map shows what moved.
defaultPrompt: Map our whole footprint across search, AI answers and social for [domain].
Which topics rank well that our social has never touched?
Turn our top keyword gaps into a social campaign in Planable.
